text: For messages API changes, preserve decoded inline text of every supported text/* subtype, including text/calendar and rich text. Do not replace calendar data with rendered invitation HTML. A text attachment or text inside an attached message is not part of the outer message body. Keep fixtures for missing Content-Type, charsets, base64/quoted-printable, empty text, nested multipart and decrypted messages. Current listInlineTextParts recurses through multipart children and returns content/contentType for non-attachment text with a nonempty body. Commit 259 tested a documentation helper; the helper is now an API method. Scope: messages MIME extraction. Source and tests inspected; no test execution.
title: Inline message body extraction must preserve MIME types and attachment boundaries
